assumptions: Only completed/declined/failed purchases are selected; pending and other financial activities remain outside model scoring.
MCCs are assigned from broad categories for this experiment, not established by the source.
ecommerce and mobile_app purchases are assumed Online Transaction.
Unknown pos technology is tested as both Chip Transaction and Swipe Transaction.
Merchant IDs are authored hashes of name+country, or name+country+city+state. Neither represents verified merchant identity.
Merchant city/state are preserved; ZIP remains missing. No device/IP location is substituted.
August reference profiles are not predictors for V13 and are not joined. The guide's rule-point expectations describe the retired engine.
No confirmed fraud labels or feedback are available. Cases identify situations, not fraudulent transactions.
scope: Unlabeled generated-data sensitivity experiment. No tuning or training.
